response.sql: WITH status_counts AS (SELECT archstat AS status, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM scanqc GROUP BY archstat), shares AS (SELECT status, record_count, record_count::numeric / SUM(record_count) OVER () AS share FROM status_counts), compared AS (SELECT status, record_count, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share FROM shares) SELECT status, record_count, share, share - average_share AS above_average_share FROM compared WHERE share > average_share;
